headline: My WordPress site is hacked or broken
steps: Look at what is wrong: scan the site for malware and check for errors.
Take a full backup before changing anything.
Clean the infected files or fix what is broken.
Update the site and change the passwords so it stays fixed.
Tell you in plain words what happened and what was done.

packages.name: Emergency Fix / Malware Cleanup
packages.detail: One site. Scan, cleanup, security update and a plain-language summary.

packages.name: Speed and Tracking Fix
packages.detail: Make a slow site faster and fix broken analytics or conversion tracking.

packages.name: Migration or Plugin Rebuild
packages.detail: Move a site to a new host or theme, or rebuild a plugin. Quoted after a quick look.
